scope: Owner-requested October 23, 2026 welcome hero for the Arc page: a short greeting, one line on the import, and the Sunrise Spectrum app icon. All three claims rest on public v1.43.1; the app icon line was an owner waiver from October 23 until v1.43.0 shipped the icon.

arcImport.qualification: User-selected local sidebar import, not a live connection or account migration. Each selected Space becomes a Blanc Space; loose pins remain pinned and folders become groups. Optional top-row Favorites go to the Arc folder. No sign-ins, passwords, history, archived tabs, Notes or Easels. Linux requires a copied sidebar file. Real-sidebar hand checks do not establish Intel Mac or x64 Windows acceptance.

appIcon.qualification: Sunrise Spectrum is a macOS-only app icon choice, shipped in v1.43.0 (#1069) and in v1.43.1. On Windows and Linux there is no app icon choice.
